feeds.title: Saprea Blog
feeds.description: Saprea exists to liberate individuals and society from child sexual abuse and its lasting impacts. We are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit public charity. We empower healing for individuals who were sexually abused as children or adolescents through retreats, support groups, and online resources. Our blogs offer many helpful resources, steps, and other survivor stories to assist in childhood sexual abuse recovery.

feeds.title: Association for the Treatment of Sexual Abusers Blog
feeds.description: ATSA's Sexual Abuse is a blog dedicated to research-based examinations of research, treatment, policy, and practice regarding sexual abuse and sexual abuse prevention.

feeds.title: Kennedy Law Firm Blog
feeds.description: With more than 75 years of combined experience, the professionals at Kennedy Law Firm strive every day to make communities in New Mexico safer by helping those who have suffered sexual abuse or police misconduct. This Sexual Abuse blog by Kennedy Law Firm offers information and commentary for residents of Albuquerque, New Mexico. We would love to hear what you think.

feeds.title: Freely in Hope » Prevent Child Sexual Abuse
feeds.description: We are survivors, advocates, scholars, and leaders who live freely because we are no longer victimized by the pain of the past. And here we share stories of Child Sexual Abuse and how to prevent it. Together, we are getting closer and closer to the day sexual violence is history - believing that hope is always present.

feeds.title: Saprea Blog
feeds.description: Saprea exists to liberate individuals and society from child sexual abuse and its lasting impacts. We empower healing for individuals who were sexually abused as children or adolescents through retreats, support groups, and online resources. We educate and engage parents and caregivers to protect children from sexual abuse through community and online resources.

feeds.title: Lauren's Kids
feeds.description: Lauren's Kids is based in South Florida and educates adults and children about sexual abuse prevention through in-school curricula, awareness campaigns, and speaking engagements around the country and the world. Our mission is to prevent child sexual abuse through education and awareness and to help survivors heal with guidance and support.

feeds.title: Enough Abuse Campaign
feeds.description: Enough Abuse is a citizen education and community mobilization initiative working to prevent child sexual abuse in our homes, schools, youth organizations, and communities. We are providing adults and communities with the knowledge and skills they need to put an end to the silence, and eventually, the epidemic of child sexual abuse.

feeds.title: Emmott Snell Blog » Sexual Abuse
feeds.description: Emmott Snell is a niche firm of personal injury solicitors committed to helping survivors of sexual abuse achieve rightful compensation. We offer a bespoke holistic service, offering the highest level of client care, referral to appropriate support agencies, and the best possible legal outcome.

feeds.title: me too
feeds.description: In 2006, the 'me too.' The movement was founded by a survivor and activist Tarana Burke. In 2017, the #metoo hashtag went viral and woke up the world to the magnitude of the problem of sexual violence. Today, our work continues to focus on assisting a growing spectrum of survivors - young people, queer, trans, the disabled, Black women and girls, and all communities of color.

feeds.title: Sexual Assault Resource Agency Blog
feeds.description: The Sexual Assault Resource Agency (SARA) is a 501(c)3 non-profit agency working to eliminate sexual violence and its impacts through education, advocacy, and support services. Learn more about our work through weekly blog posts from the staff.

feeds.title: Victoria Sexual Assault Centre Blog
feeds.description: The Victoria Sexual Assault Centre is a feminist organization committed to ending sexualized violence through healing, education, and prevention. We are dedicated to supporting women and all trans survivors of sexual assault and childhood sexual abuse, through advocacy, counselling, and empowerment.

feeds.title: Organised Abuse Blog
feeds.description: I am the Scientia Associate Professor in Criminology at the University of New South Wales, Australia. I specialize in the study of organized sexual abuse. In addition to my work on complex trauma, I have researched and published widely on violence against women and children.

feeds.title: Options Domestic & Sexual Violence Services Blog
feeds.description: Options Domestic and Sexual Violence Services is a non-profit organization that aids victims and survivors of domestic and sexual violence, stalking, and human trafficking to, women, children, and men. The mission of Options is to empower individuals who experience domestic, sexual, interpersonal, or stalking violence through individual support while educating our communities to identify and confront the causes of violence in society.

feeds.title: Horowitz Law Blog
feeds.description: Horowitz Law handles only sexual abuse cases. Our team dedicates themselves to advocating for sexual abuse victims across the country and we have a well-earned reputation for being among the best in the country at it. As a result, we have a very thorough and unique understanding of the dynamics of representing sexual abuse survivors in civil sexual abuse claims.

feeds.title: NWA Center for Sexual Assault Blog
feeds.description: Founded as NWA Rape Crisis, through mission-driven work, our center has offered free comprehensive support to adult survivors of sexual assault since 1982. Official blog of NWA Center for Sexual Assault. Being here is the first step in creating a community of knowledge-seekers, activists, allies, and survivors. Our library shares prevention and educational resources, self-care tips, and stories to inspire.

feeds.title: Heal with MirabelAmbrose
feeds.description: Heal with MirabelAmbrose offers resources and mental support on topics surrounding Sexual Abuse. Abuba Mirabel is the author of four excellent books and a creative writing director. She writes about people who are victims of Sexual Abuse, Rape, Domestic Violence, and non-consensual incest.

feeds.title: Ehline Law Firm Blog » Sexual Assault
feeds.description: The premier Ehline Law Firm in Greater Los Angeles, California is a nationwide, award-winning plaintiff's personal injury office offering legal help in multiple U.S. Courts and state courts. We serve people injured in accidents involving a passenger car, motorcycle, dog bite, bicycle, commercial bus, Uber/Lyft, cruise ship mishap, and physical injuries caused by a defendant's negligence, including child neglect and elderly abuse. Read All about sexual assault, stories, articles, laws, and more here.

feeds.title: Yo digo NO MÁS Blog
feeds.description: Yo Digo No Más is a non-profit dedicated to protecting Latino children and families, supporting initial healing for those who have survived sexual abuse, and speaking out against this silent epidemic.

feeds.title: Thriving After Sexual Abuse Blog
feeds.description: Denise Bossarte is a poet, and award-winning writer, photographer, and artist. Denise is a certified meditation facilitator and contemplative arts teacher. And she is a survivor of childhood sexual abuse. She is a thriver who has traveled a healing journey and is able to share a personal, guided experience for readers to find and engage in their own journey to healing, to becoming thriving.

feeds.title: CSA Centre Blog
feeds.description: The CSA Centre blog is a space for our staff members and partners to blog about our work, good practices, and challenges that society faces concerning child sexual abuse. We are the Centre of expertise on child sexual abuse (CSA Centre). We want children to be able to live free from the threat and harm of sexual abuse. Our aim is to reduce the impact of child sexual abuse through improved prevention and better response.

feeds.title: EmpowerSurvivors Blog
feeds.description: EmpowerSurvivors was created and founded by Elizabeth Sullivan in 2014. It was during her own healing journey that she realized survivors needed an organization that would provide safe spaces of healing and support. Along with the safe spaces, Elizabeth knew that it was equally important to provide resources and education, so survivors could better understand their own healing journey and how the child abuse that happened to them so many years ago, could manifest itself into every fiber of their being.

feeds.title: MenHealing Blog
feeds.description: MenHealing retreats are thoughtfully planned healing experiences designed to inform, inspire, and support men who have been sexually victimized as adults or children. No other organization offers this innovative healing resource.

feeds.title: Deb Talan Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to my Childhood Sexual Abuse/Incest Survivor Blog and resource area. I'm creating this place in my corner of the internet, in hopes that it might offer some comfort, support, and information to other survivors. I've found it so helpful, over the last 16 years of my own healing journey, to learn from the insights and experiences of other survivors.

feeds.title: New Jersey Employment Lawyer Blog » Sexual Harassment
feeds.description: Published by New Jersey Employment Attorneys Phillips & Associates, read articles, surviving stories, and more on Sexual Harassment. The law firm of Phillips & Associates is a recognized leader in the field of workplace harassment and discrimination. Our employment discrimination attorneys handle, High Profile Harassment Cases as well as all other types of sexual assault and discrimination recovering millions of dollars for our clients.

feeds.title: Haven Network Blog
feeds.description: The Haven - The Survivors' Network supports young people and adults who have suffered childhood sexual violence and/or abuse, domestic violence, and rape. Follow our blog page where we post all our latest news and thoughts on Sexual Abuse & Domestic Violence.

feeds.title: SNAP Blog
feeds.description: SNAP is an independent, peer network of survivors of institutional sexual abuse and their supporters who work to support survivors, protect children, protect the vulnerable, heal the wounded, and expose the truth. We are SNAP, the largest, oldest, and most active support group for women and men wounded by religious and institutional authorities (priests, ministers, bishops, deacons, nuns, coaches, teachers, and others).

feeds.title: Sexual Abuse Rape Advice Centre (SARAC)
feeds.description: SARAC (Sexual Abuse Rape Advice Centre) is a charity based in Burton upon Trent offering free, independent, and one-to-one emotional support, information, and advice. Our specialist support is for everyone over 11 years of age who have been affected at any time in their lives. We partner with our clients to expand their choices, facilitate recovery and encourage personal growth.

feeds.title: The Survivors Trust
feeds.description: The Survivors Trust is the largest umbrella agency for specialist rape and sexual abuse services in the UK and has been providing infrastructure support to our members for the past 20 years. It is not uncommon for survivors to feel alone and isolated. For many, hearing and sharing stories can play a vital role in their recovery from trauma. All of these stories are written directly by survivors and therefore contain triggering material and the occasional swear word.

feeds.title: Thorn Blog » Child Abuse
feeds.description: We build technology and digital programs to defend children from sexual abuse. Find material on Child Sexual Abuse here in the following segment. Thorn was born in 2012. Our co-founders Ashton Kutcher and Demi Moore had learned about the issue of child sex trafficking from a documentary highlighting what was happening to children in Cambodia.

feeds.title: Jessica Pride Blog
feeds.description: At The Pride Law Firm, we understand the personal, traumatic nature of the sexual assault. With over 20 years of combined experience, we've helped hundreds of people just like yourself regain their sense of confidence and peace. Read about important sexual assault-related topics such as safety tips, new laws, cases we are working on, and current events. Click here to find a topic.

feeds.title: Surviving My Past
feeds.description: Surviving My Past exists to validate and encourage all who have survived the trauma of abuse. My name is Matt Pappas and I am a survivor of Childhood Sexual Abuse, Narcissistic Abuse, and Bullying. This blog is my story of living with Dissociation, Anxiety, and PTSD, shared openly in writing, podcasts, and videos.

feeds.title: Gianforcaro Law Blog » Sexual Abuse
feeds.description: Experiencing sexual abuse, or finding out that one of your children has been victimized in this way, is nothing short of tragic. You need someone on your side who you can trust to help you through the legal landscape and to help you obtain justice and compensation. At Gianforcaro Law, we have been helping New Jersey clients with childhood sexual abuse claims for 30 years. From our home office in Phillipsburg, our head lawyer and our entire legal team focus on our clients.

feeds.title: Carrillo Law Firm Blog » Sexual Abuse
feeds.description: Our team is led by Luis Carrillo, who has over 41 years of experience as a trial lawyer and has seen and helped families through their most difficult times. From child sexual abuse to police excessive force, to catastrophic injury and wrongful death, we know what it takes to fight for your rights. Find articles on sexual abuse but expert attorneys in the following segment of the blog.
